text: Enterprise & Business Connectivity Commercial Policy Document ID: Policy_C23_enterprise_terms Category: C23 — Enterprise & Business Services Department: Enterprise Sales Customer Scope: all Version: 1.0 Last Updated: 2026-08-08 Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base Policy Statement Sets the general commercial and service framework for enterprise and business customers, superseded in specifics by individually signed agreements. Purpose Ensures consistent, compliant, and customer-fair treatment across all channels and customer segments. Scope Applies to all prepaid, postpaid, and (where noted) enterprise customers, and to all NovaTel-authorised channels. Definitions **Customer** — any individual or entity holding an active NovaTel connection or account. **Working day** — a business day excluding weekends and public holidays. Eligibility Applies to customers with an active, KYC-verified account in good standing, subject to the rules and exceptions below. Rules Enterprise pricing is volume-tiered and subject to a minimum committed line count. Each enterprise account is assigned a dedicated Account Manager and centralised billing. Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for connectivity uptime and fault-resolution time are defined per contract, typically stricter than standard consumer SLAs. Exceptions Enterprise/pooled accounts may follow their signed commercial agreement instead. Approval Requirements Exceptions to standard rules require documented supervisor or department-head approval before being applied. Responsibilities Compliance Requirements This policy is designed to align with applicable regulatory requirements (e.g. TRAI/DoT guidance) as general background context; it is not a substitute for legal advice.
